name: JavOrganizer
overview: JAV metadata and cover art from 18 websites, scraped in parallel
description: Identifies JAV titles by product code in the file name and scrapes up to 18 websites simultaneously per code — JavLibrary, JavDB, JavBus, MissAV (+mirror), OneJAV, FANZA/DMM digital + DVD, JavLand, 123AV, SEXTB, SupJav, JavGG, JavSeen, JavMix, JavQuick, JavTube and MGStage — merging English titles, actresses and male actors, studio, genres, release date, runtime, cover art and scene backdrops. Advanced anti-ban system, Cloudflare bypass via optional FlareSolverr, automatic scanning, manual Scan page with live progress, gender browse collections ordered by total views, and gender-aware people collections.

versions.changelog: Main-menu Scan page (manual scan buttons one click from anywhere, with progress bar, elapsed time and ETA); gender browse collections — Female Actresses and Male Actors cards chaining every performer ordered by total views with release-date blocks; Japanese-title self-healing on scheduled scans; plus all 1.3.0 fixes: 18-site scraping with site cap, English-first merging, error pages never parsed, fixed Cloudflare detection, per-host Referer covers, advanced anti-ban, cancel-safe deep scan.

18-site scraping with per-code site cap and priority ranking; English-first merging; error pages never parse into records; fixed Cloudflare detection; per-host Referer image downloads; advanced anti-ban/anti-detect; automatic scraping (startup + 6-hourly task + self-healing); manual Scan/Deep/Cancel buttons; JavBus rewritten against real markup; 82-check test suite.
